collectible.skycraft.treasures_akavir.ak: A crimson wax and lacquered-iron talisman sworn to the Dragonborn of old.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_akavir.ka: An ivory canine etched with Tosh Raka's black-and-orange flame glyphs.
An enchanted glacial core that weeps cold brine when summer nears.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_akavir.ta: A carved monkey-clan signet stamp of translucent green nephrite.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_akavir.ts: A shed scale of gilded viper-horn from a Reman-era potentate.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_atmora.at: An aurochs drinking horn banded in silver from the halls of Forelhost's kin.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_atmora.br: Resin of the last green pines of Atmora, frozen solid in blue ice.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_atmora.cl: Jhunal's winged totem carved in whalebone before the Dragon Cult's fall.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_atmora.jy: A salt-rime oak plank from the shipyards of the southern Atmoran coast.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_atmora.ys: A bronze-bound lodestone needle that still points toward Saarthal.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_pyandonea: An iridescent grey pearl harvested from the flagship reefs of Pyandonea.
Cured pellicle that shifts hue to match the palm that holds it.
Mintless gold that smells of abyssal ozone, spilled from Orgnum's bottomless chest.
A hollow translucent fang through which Maormer wizards whistle to the deep coils.
A spiral shell inlaid with moonstone that roars with distant squalls.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_realm.apo: Dredged from the ink-seas of Hermaeus Mora; it whispers forgotten footnotes.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_realm.col: Uncongealed blue creatia that flickers like a drowned lantern.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_realm.shi: Half golden Gnarl-sap, half humming face-forged metal from New Sheoth.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_realm.sig: A warm obsidian hemisphere etched with Daedric morpholith runes.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_realm.sou: A jagged purple crystal from the Ideal Masters' bone-citadels.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_thras.aga: Pink brain-coral grown around a sunken bronze nautical astrolabe.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_thras.all: Bend'r-mahk gold salvaged from the wreck of Baron-Admiral Amiel's vanguard.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_thras.kre: A heavy violet-black pearl dredged from the sacrificial sinkholes of Thras.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_thras.nec: Hollow staghorn coral etched with the drowning-ciphers of N'Gasta.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_thras.slo: Sealed with wax from the Pillar of Thras; alchemists pay dearly and ask no questions.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_yokuda.le: Twisted bronze worn by the Left-Handed Elves in their final war against Diagna.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_yokuda.me: A blue crystal that murmurs the final vows of a First-Rank Ansei.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_yokuda.na: Hammered gold from the High Court of Ravan before the Redguards sailed east.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_yokuda.or: Green-gold masonry from the sunken tower of Old Yokuda.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_yokuda.ta: Carved from reef-coral; blowing it raises a warm westerly breeze.
collection.skycraft.treasures_akavir: Tsaesci & Tang Mo Relics of Akavir
collection.skycraft.treasures_akavir.des: Artefacts of the Dragon Land across the Padomaic: serpent scales, jade seals and Dragonguard heirlooms. Found in that land's chests and hoards.
collection.skycraft.treasures_atmora: Elder Wood & Frost Relics of Atmora
collection.skycraft.treasures_atmora.des: Heirlooms of the Elder Wood before the Great Freeze: totem carvings, mead-horns and Five Hundred Companions relics. Found in that land's chests and hoards.
Coiled treasures of King Orgnum's veil-mist archipelago and the Maormer fleets. Found in that land's chests and hoards.
collection.skycraft.treasures_realm: Planar Curios of the Outer Realms
collection.skycraft.treasures_realm.desc: Relics carried back from Coldharbour, the Deadlands, the Shivering Isles, Apocrypha and the Soul Cairn. Found in planar chests and hoards.
collection.skycraft.treasures_thras.desc: Grim curiosities of the Sload's sinking coral atolls and the All Flags Navy's ruin. Found in that land's chests and hoards.
collection.skycraft.treasures_yokuda.des: Sunken remnants of the Old Fatherland before the Pankratosword tore the continent apart. Found in that land's chests and hoards.
